record.question: His mother was 45 when she __________.
record.explanation: Answer B: died. The past event is “when she died” (B); had died would require a later past reference point. Independent check: A completed event in a past time clause takes simple past: “when she died.” Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/past-simple-i-work. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
